author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices lines that start alike, big jumps, dotted rhythms, repeating pairs and low left-hand notes, with a joyful Christmas carol.

classes.title: Thumb on C, ready to sing
classes.goal: Find the hand position, thumb on C, and learn the first line.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finding the hand's home: thumb on C, five fingers ready

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child rest the thumb on C and one finger on each next key.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, fingers on the next keys, then play line one.
classes.bridge: Thumb sits on C, left of the two black keys; low G waits outside.

intro.caption: Find your hand's home
intro.parentCue: thumb on C, just left of the two black keys.

games.caption: Hark! The herald angels sing
games.parentCue: Point to each key as it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's home and line one.

classes.title: Same start, two roads
classes.goal: Learn the next part: two lines that start on G, then go different ways.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines start on the same G, then go different ways

classes.parentPrompt: Play both lines; ask your child which one ends way down low.
classes.childAction: Play both lines and find where they stop matching.
classes.bridge: Both lines start up high on G; one stays up, one walks down left.

intro.caption: Two lines, one starting note
intro.parentCue: ask which line ends way down low.

games.caption: Two endings: up, then down low

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing lines that start the same.

classes.title: Three G's and a big jump
classes.goal: Learn the joyful part: three G's, then a big jump down to C.

mathTarget.parentLine: From the top key, a big jump down to the thumb

classes.parentPrompt: Show your child: the pinky plays the three G's, then the thumb plays C.
classes.childAction: Pinky plays G, G, G; then thumb plays C. Big jump!
classes.bridge: Three G's ring out on the right; C is the drum below.

intro.caption: Joyful G's, then jump!
intro.parentCue: pinky on G, thumb ready on C.

games.caption: Joyful: G, G, G, then C
games.parentCue: Pinky on G, thumb on C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a big jump from pinky to thumb.

classes.title: Lines that come in pairs
classes.goal: Play the whole carol slowly and spot each line that repeats.

mathTarget.parentLine: Spotting lines that repeat, so there is less to learn

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up two fingers each time a line repeats; sing words if your child stalls.
classes.childAction: Play the whole song slowly; spot each line that repeats.
classes.bridge: The carol is built in pairs: many lines come twice.

intro.caption: Spot the pairs
intro.parentCue: hold up two fingers when a line repeats.

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding repeating lines in a song.

classes.title: Climb up, skip home
classes.goal: Practise the climb and the dotted skip slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: One long note and a tiny one, like a skip

classes.parentPrompt: Play it slowly; say 'looong-tiny' on the skip, then a little faster.
classes.childAction: Climb D, E, F, G, then skip home: C, D, C.
classes.bridge: Four steps up a ladder, a jump down, and a skip home to C.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: steps up and a dotted skip.

classes.title: The low bell note
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: The left hand plays low notes, on the left side

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; count bars aloud so your child plays one low note each.
classes.childAction: Play one low note with your left hand on each 'one'.
classes.bridge: The left hand rings a low bell on the left at every bar.

intro.caption: The low bell note
intro.parentCue: count one at each new bar

games.caption: Same C, two houses
games.parentCue: Ask: which C sounds like a bell?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: low notes with the left hand.

classes.title: Two hands sing together
classes.goal: Play the tune with one low left-hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each hand has its own job; they meet on the 'one'

classes.parentPrompt: Go very slowly; say 'one' each time both hands play together.
classes.childAction: Left hand on 'one', right hand plays the tune, slowly.
classes.bridge: Both hands land together on 'one', like two voices in a choir.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: go very slowly and stop while it's fun.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: giving each hand its own job.

classes.title: Sing with the choir
classes.goal: Play the whole carol along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part going while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit close and nod the beat; if a note is missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes are fine; keep going!
classes.bridge: The music is a big choir; you sing along on the keys.

intro.caption: Join the choir
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and keep going, whatever happens.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music, together.

classes.title: Carol concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole carol for teddy, big and joyful, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing bright and strong, like happy news called out

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; ask for big, joyful playing, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play big and joyful for teddy, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: A herald calls out happy news: strong fingers, bright sound.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: bright, joyful playing, start to end.
